title: Command Centre data store and open work dashboard
objective: Create dashboard widgets and backing tables or views that count data stores, GitHub repositories, PEN artifacts, bridge jobs, dev/prod/open work states, file counts, storage sizes, issues, risks, and data quality concerns.
must_include: Open work across queued active validating blocked stale missing receipt no proof bridge pending pen pending dev pending prod promotion pending
kpi_cards: Zero size or near empty repos
acceptance_criteria: Counts include prod dev PEN bridge and non-prod states
Every number has a source and evidence state
Dashboard marks unavailable sources as PARTIAL or BLOCKED
Open work is counted even when not in prod
Bridge returns receipt with SQL results API counts file counts sizes row counts and blockers
